title: Plugin approval response
description: What the plugin approval page posts after the passkey signs: the body of POST /api/v1/plugins/{approvalId}/approve, on the engine's own pages or through the Vault. It is never shown to paste. Byte fields are base64url without padding. Any relay may carry it; basalt_meta.submit_plugin_approval verifies it. See CONTRACT.md, Plugins, Plugin approval.

signature.description: ASN.1 DER ECDSA signature (ES256) over authenticatorData ‖ sha256(clientDataJSON); clientDataJSON.challenge is sha256(binding text).
